title: Vim for Windows Uncontrolled Search Path Element Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Vim for Windows. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must open a malicious file and perform one of a set of specific actions in the editor. The specific flaw exists within the launching of external executables from the editor process. The product executes a program from an unsecured location. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of current user.
